battle.automatic_battle:
Set automatic battle mode for wild Pokémon interactions when enemy HP is 0. 
[0: Disabled, 1: Auto-catch, 2: Auto-defeat (to gain XP), 3: Catch if NEW Pokémon (not in collection), otherwise defeat].
battle.auto_catch_wishlist: List of Pokémon IDs that are always caught when encountered, regardless of other auto-catch settings.
battle.auto_catch_legendary: Always catch Legendary Pokémon when encountered.
battle.auto_catch_mythical: Always catch Mythical Pokémon when encountered.
battle.auto_catch_ultra: Always catch Ultra Beast Pokémon when encountered.
battle.auto_catch_starter: Always catch Starter Pokémon when encountered.
battle.auto_catch_mega: Always catch Mega Evolution Pokémon when encountered.
battle.auto_catch_gmax: Always catch Gigantamax Pokémon when encountered.
battle.auto_catch_regional: Always catch Regional Form Pokémon when encountered.
battle.cards_per_round: Number of cards to review per round until the next battle action. (For dynamic values use a-b [e.g. 1-3])
battle.daily_average: Set the amount of Cards you want to review per day.
battle.card_max_time: Goal of maximum amount of time needed to answer a card in seconds
battle.review_based_damage: If enabled, your Pokémon's damage will be modified depending on how you graded your last few cards.
evolution.friendship_time_enabled: Let Pokémon evolve when they reach their friendship requirement at the right time of day (day/night).
evolution.timezone_auto: Use this device's local time zone to decide day vs night for evolutions. Turn off to set a fixed UTC offset below.
evolution.timezone_offset: UTC offset in hours used for the day/night cycle when Auto-detect Time Zone is off (e.g. -5 = New York, 1 = Berlin, 5.5 = India, 0 = UTC). Ignored while auto-detect is on.
controls.pokemon_buttons: Enable action buttons for Pokémon commands during reviews.
controls.defeat_key: Key for defeating Pokémon when its HP is 0. [A-Z]
controls.catch_key: Key for catching Pokémon when its HP is 0. [A-Z]
controls.team_cycle_key: Key for cycling to the next Pokémon in your team. [A-Z or 0-9]
controls.key_for_opening_closing_ankimon: Key to open/close Ankimon interface with control/command key. Write the keys like 'Shift+N' you can also add things like Ctrl, Shift, and multiple button combinations
controls.allow_to_choose_moves: Allows player to manually pick attack moves in battles with Keys 1-4 or fast click.
gui.animate_time: Enable a small animation for Pokémon interactions. This animation is displayed when you or the wild Pokémon is taking damage.
gui.gif_in_collection: Show animated sprites (GIFs) instead of static sprites in the collection view.
gui.show_sprites_across_ankimon: Disable this setting to hide all Ankimon-related visual elements, such as sprites, GIFs, and HP/XP bars. This includes images in the Pokémon PC, Trainer Card, Item Shop, and reviewer. Text and descriptions will be retained. Great for focus sessions or a word-based presentation. Only exclusion: Mon sprites are still shown in the Ankimon Window (Ctrl+Shift+P).
gui.hud_styling: Apply custom CSS styles to enhance reviewer HUD visuals.
gui.pop_up_dialog_message_on_defeat: Show a pop-up message when a wild Pokémon is defeated.
gui.pop_up_dialog_message_on_item: Show a pop-up window when you receive an item. Turning this off still awards the item, it just does not interrupt your reviews.
gui.review_hp_bar_thickness: Set the HP bar thickness for reviews [2: 8px, 3: 12px, 4: 16px, 5: 20px].
gui.reviewer_image_gif: Display Pokémon GIFs in the reviewer window.
gui.reviewer_text_message_box: Enable colorful pop-up messages in the reviewer.
gui.reviewer_text_message_box_time: Duration for message box display in seconds [1-5].
gui.show_mainpkmn_in_reviewer: Show main Pokémon in reviewer. [0: Hide, 1: Same level view, 2: Battle view]
gui.hud_hidden_on_startup: Hide the Heads-Up Display (HUD) when the reviewer starts.
gui.team_deck_view: Enable a quick overview of your Pokémon team at the bottom of the deck overview.
gui.view_main_front: View front of main Pokémon in reviewer when GIFs are enabled. Set Disabled to show from the back.
gui.xp_bar_location: Location of the XP bar in the reviewer. [1: Top, 2: Bottom]
gui.hud_player_sprite: Show or hide the player's Pokémon sprite on the reviewer HUD.
gui.hud_enemy_sprite: Show or hide the enemy Pokémon sprite on the reviewer HUD.
gui.hud_xp_bar: Show or hide the player's Pokémon XP progress bar on the reviewer HUD.
gui.hud_hp_bars: Show or hide the HP bars on the reviewer HUD.
gui.hud_hp_text: Show or hide the current/max HP values text on the reviewer HUD.
gui.hud_pokemon_id: Show or hide the Pokédex ID next to Pokémon names on the reviewer HUD.
gui.hud_pokemon_gen: Show or hide the generation next to Pokémon names on the reviewer HUD.
gui.hud_pokemon_lvl: Show or hide the level next to Pokémon names on the reviewer HUD.
gui.hud_pokemon_name: Show or hide Pokémon names on the reviewer HUD.
gui.hud_status_badge: Show or hide the wild Pokémon status/type badge on the reviewer HUD.
gui.hud_owned_indicator: Show or hide the Pokeball owned-indicator icon on the reviewer HUD.
gui.hud_enemy_shiny_indicator: Show or hide the shiny star indicator next to the wild/enemy Pokémon name on the reviewer HUD.
gui.hud_player_shiny_indicator: Show or hide the shiny star indicator next to your main Pokémon name on the reviewer HUD.
audio.sound_effects: Enable sound effects for various Pokémon actions.
audio.sounds: Enable general Pokémon sounds during interactions.
audio.battle_sounds: Enable recurring battle cries every 10 cards.
misc.active_region: Restrict wild encounters to Pokémon native to the selected region. Choose 'No Region' to allow encounters from all enabled generations.
misc.remove_level_cap: Allow leveling beyond set level cap.
misc.language: Select language ID for Pokémon names and descriptions. [1: Japanese (Hir & Kata), 2: Japanese (Roomaji), 3: Korean, 4: Chinese (Traditional), 5: French, 6: German, 7: Spanish, 8: Italian, 9: English, 10: Czech, 11: Japanese, 12: Chinese (Simplified), 13: Portuguese (Brazil), 14: Spanish (Latin America)]
misc.ssh: Enable SSH if encountering connectivity issues (like Eduroam restrictions).
misc.leaderboard: Enable synchronization with Ankimon leaderboard. To set up, enter your Username and API Key below.
misc.ankiweb_sync:
Sync your Ankimon SAVE DATA (Pokémon, items, trainer progress) across your own devices that share one AnkiWeb account, by riding Anki's media sync. When ON, your local save is backed up automatically and integrity-checked before any incoming data is applied.
This is SEPARATE from Mobile Reviews: reviews done on AnkiMobile/AnkiDroid become battles regardless of this setting.
Tips: don't use 'Delete Unused' when checking media, and avoid playing on two devices between syncs (the most recent sync wins).
misc.YouShallNotPass_Ankimon_News: If enabled, you will not receive news pop-ups when Ankimon starts (like changelogs and updates).
misc.discord_rich_presence: Enable Discord Rich Presence for Ankimon. Shows in Discord as 'Playing Ankimon'.
misc.discord_rich_presence_text: Set to 1 for Ankimon Quotes or set to 2 for showing what Pokémon you are battle against or with
misc.show_tip_on_startup: If enabled, a window with a helpful tip about Ankimon will be shown when you start Anki!
misc.developer_mode: Enable developer mode. This will create a backup every time Anki is opened.
trainer.name: Set the name of your trainer.
trainer.cash_reward_amount: How much cash you earn for each interval of cards reviewed. [Min: 10, Max: 400]. NOTE: To prevent exploits, the payout is capped based on your daily economy limit and subject to a hard daily cap of 400¥.
trainer.cash_reward_interval: Number of cards to review before earning cash. [Min: 5, Max: 100]. Earnings are subject to a maximum daily cap of 400¥.
leaderboard.username: Your username for the Ankimon leaderboard. This will be displayed publicly on the leaderboard.
leaderboard.api_key: Your API key for the Ankimon leaderboard. Get one from the Ankimon website at https://leaderboard.ankimon.com/
